biography:
With over eight years of experience in  construction management and project controls, currently supporting Turner & Townsend as a Senior Cost Manager. Focus areas include overseeing cost management and reporting for data center projects valued at approximately $1 billion. Contributions include implementing real-time cost reporting using Power BI and managing contractor compliance, change orders, and payment applications to achieve measurable savings and process improvements.  

Previous experience includes cost engineering for major infrastructure projects, such as the $4 billion Hampton Roads Bridge and Tunnel Project. Developed actionable KPIs and dashboards to track progress, safety, and quality. Skilled in construction estimating, project planning, and collaborative contract management. Dedicated to leveraging technology and precision to ensure project success and cost efficiency.
